answer: Require every agent to stake tokens before it can trade, like a bridge toll: the stake is locked in a public atlas of identities, so one operator running a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand stakes. A mesa of reputation then forms — agents that behave honestly climb it and earn cheaper access, while caught fakes lose their stake and fall off. Sybil attacks stay possible but become ruinously expensive, because each fake identity now carries a real, forfeitable cost instead of being free.
